manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps changing it: a = -g. A release gate releases a second ball at that moment.
manifest.description: Two lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball side by side. At the apex, a gate opens to release the second ball from rest.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare velocity and acceleration.
